items.topic: 英伟达129亿美元买下Hugging Face：开源AI的“中立广场”被算力巨头收编

sources.name: NVIDIA Blog
sources.title: NVIDIA to Acquire Hugging Face
sources.excerpt: NVIDIA says Hugging Face will remain open, multi-cloud and multi-accelerator; hosts 3M models and 18M developers.

sources.name: TechCrunch
sources.title: Nvidia confirms it will buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
sources.excerpt: Deal frames open-model hub as distribution and unused compute channel for Nvidia.

sources.name: The Next Web
sources.title: Nvidia confirms it is buying Hugging Face for $12.93bn and promises to leave it open
sources.excerpt: Highlights neutrality question, regulatory risk, and valuation near 86x revenue.

items.hook: Hugging Face最值钱的不是代码，而是“大家默认先去那里”的入口；现在这个入口被GPU公司买了。
items.angle: 从“开源平台被收购”切到“AI分发入口+算力入口合并”，讨论中立承诺为什么反而暴露结构性矛盾。
items.dedup: 低重复：8/28写过OpenAI攻入Hugging Face沙箱，但本次是NVIDIA并购/平台中立性，主事件与角度不同。

items.topic: 库克交棒John Ternus：苹果AI时代不找软件CEO，反而押硬件工程师

sources.name: Reuters via WHBL
sources.title: Cook hands Apple to Ternus: bigger and richer, but catching up in AI race
sources.excerpt: Cook shifts to executive chairman; hardware chief John Ternus inherits AI and supply-chain test.

sources.name: International Finance
sources.title: John Ternus takes the Apple helm, eyes AI revolution and foldable iPhones
sources.excerpt: Ternus first product moment is expected Sept. 9, with foldable iPhone and rebuilt AI/Siri pressure.

items.hook: 苹果最缺AI，董事会却把CEO交给硬件负责人——这可能不是保守，而是苹果对AI终局的判断。
items.angle: 不是写“库克退休传记”，而是写“苹果认为AI入口仍要回到设备”。
items.dedup: 低重复：过去7天未写Apple/CEO交接；与Google/OpenAI模型发布不同。

items.topic: HiddenLayer融1亿美元：AI Agent安全从功能补丁变成独立赛道

sources.name: Yahoo Finance
sources.title: The $100M Signal: Why AI Agent Security is Becoming Its Own Category
sources.excerpt: HiddenLayer $100M round and $150M+ recent category funding frame agent security as standalone market.

items.hook: 当Agent能点按钮、拿数据、调用系统，安全就不能再只管“人”和“账号”了。
items.angle: 从融资信号切入：企业不是害怕模型聊天，而是害怕“会行动的软件员工”没有安保层。
items.dedup: 中重复：8/28与9/3写过Agent安全/沙箱，但本次是资本市场给出新类别定价；需避开“模型失控”老叙事，写企业安防预算迁移。
